baseline_models.reading: A direct pronouncement of woe falls on the muṭaffifīn: ordinarily, people who shave down or diminish what others are due.

focus_anchor.role: The doom-word is assigned by the lām phrase to a named plural agent-class; that class is the focus's sole stated target.

baseline_models.mechanism: The compact nominal warning places the sanction first and attaches it directly to the agent label, preserving the ordinary reading of culpable shortchanging without yet specifying a transaction or consequence.
baseline_models.reader_inference: Packet-supplied evidence is the exact focus wording and the absence of a mapped inventory for ط ف ف. Ordinary Arabic morphology supplies the conventional shortchanging sense of the agent noun; no additional causal or contextual assumption is needed. The focus alone leaves the precise method and victim unstated.
baseline_models.containment: Retain the ordinary short-measure reading, but do not claim branch-level nuances for ط ف ف: the packet explicitly has no mapped target for that root. Details about receiving, dispensing, judgment, or social analogy must come from cited context rather than being smuggled into this baseline.

context_deltas.reading: The label is operationally defined as a directional double standard: they exact completion when receiving from people but create deficiency when dispensing to them by measure or weight.

focus_anchor.role: The condemned agent label is the antecedent whose conduct the next two ayat unpack.

activation_trace.role: The measuring-food branch includes both receiving and dispensing a measured amount; this occurrence occupies their receiving side.
The image of complete fullness without shortfall gives force to their demand for full receipt.
The same measuring field recurs on the outward-facing side of the exchange, making the role reversal visible.
The branch image of determining a thing by weight adds the parallel weighing channel to the giving side.
This branch explicitly images shorting measure and weight, identifying the produced outcome as a deficit rather than a neutral miscalculation.

structural_cues.role: Names the class to which the following relative description attaches.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
structural_cues.role: The first conditional clause places them over against people as receivers who insist on completion.
The matched second conditional reverses direction and coordinates measuring with weighing while changing the result from fullness to loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relative descriptor ٱلَّذِينَ and the parallel إِذَا clauses define the focus class through a controlled reversal of participant roles. Repeated measuring vocabulary holds the domain constant, while يَسْتَوْفُونَ versus يُخْسِرُونَ switches the standard according to who benefits.

changed_reading.before: A generic warning against people who diminish another's due.
changed_reading.after: A warning against a stable relational policy: maximal entitlement for oneself and deliberate deficiency for the other within the same measuring system.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied elements are the paired clauses, their participant direction, and the full-measure/short-measure branch images. The inference that these clauses define the preceding agent noun follows their immediate relative construction and needs no additional causal premise. Whether the attached pronouns are heard as persons measured for or as what is measured out to them does not alter the beneficiary reversal.
context_deltas.containment: This supports intentional asymmetry in measure and weight; it does not make every arithmetic mistake tatfīf or establish a broader social metaphor by itself.

context_deltas.reading: The initially unspecified woe acquires a public judgment horizon: the exchange is carried into a severe day of standing under lordship, with later exclusion and encounter with fire supplying concrete sanction-images.

focus_anchor.role: The otherwise unspecified woe is the consequence that the subsequent judgment sequence progressively frames.

activation_trace.role: The event-day or severe-occasion image expands the warning beyond the immediate transaction.
This branch expressly joins resurrection with creatures or people standing before their Lord, giving the public summons its image.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the standing as accountable rather than merely bodily.
The blocking-access image supplies exclusion as one later specification of adverse consequence.
The image of encountering fire and its heat supplies the next consequence in the sequence.

structural_cues.role: Provides the consequence-term that context specifies.
The rebuking question makes failure to reckon with being raised the hinge from transaction to judgment.
Makes the horizon collective and locates all people before an authority.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
structural_cues.role: States exclusion on that day.
The sequential ثُمَّ adds encounter with the blaze after exclusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rhetorical question interrupts the market description and projects it onto a severe day; the standing-before-authority construction converts hidden bilateral advantage into public answerability. The later ثُمَّ sequence gives the broad woe an exclusion-and-fire contour.

changed_reading.before: Woe is a forceful but temporally and procedurally unspecified threat attached to shortchangers.
changed_reading.after: Woe is read within a summons, public standing, exclusion, and sanction sequence rather than as merely bad commercial fortune.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied elements are the rebuking question, the severe day, the standing-before-the-Lord branch, and the later exclusion/fire sequence. The reader inference is that the later sanctions elaborate the opening woe. A live alternative is that 83:15-17 apply most immediately to the deniers described in 83:10-14 rather than explicitly renaming every muṭaffif.
context_deltas.containment: Claim a judgment frame for the focus, not a proof that every later group-label is coextensive with the focus class, and do not add details about timing or procedure absent from the window.

context_deltas.reading: The shortfall is framed as durable and auditable rather than negligible: writing, a marked record, reckoning, and witnessing answer any attempt to make a small deficit disappear.

focus_anchor.role: The opening judgment on a seemingly small diminution is the conduct placed under the later record architecture.

activation_trace.role: The joining of letters into a written book supplies durable inscription rather than a passing impression.
The branch's marked writing in a book or record sharpens the image of an identifiable entry.
Reckoning and recompense turn inscription into consequential accounting.
Presence with witnessing adds public attestation to the corresponding righteous record.

structural_cues.role: Supplies the judged act-class whose apparent smallness is re-scaled.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
structural_cues.role: Introduces a written account for the wicked immediately after the resurrection question.
Compresses the first account into the repeated formula 'a marked book.'
Exact repetition for the righteous creates a two-sided, nonselective record structure.
Adds witnessing to the second record and reinforces auditability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ formula on both sides of the wicked/righteous contrast answers selective standards with symmetrical recording. Reckoning and witnessing convert the supposedly slight, private shortfall into a preserved and reviewable deed.

changed_reading.before: A short measure can look like a fleeting, locally invisible loss.
changed_reading.after: The same conduct is read as retained in an impartial record and exposed to reckoning and witness.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both occurrences of the identical record formula and the relevant writing, marking, reckoning, and witnessing images. Treating this as an answer to the opening shortfall is a sequence-and-contrast inference. The books may denote comprehensive moral records rather than literal transaction ledgers, so the audit language is analogical.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim a literal itemized commercial ledger or infer the contents of the records beyond the window. The supported point is durable, symmetrical accountability.

context_deltas.reading: The target is not desire for a better share as such: the later command to compete for a precious good distinguishes sanctioned aspiration from advantage obtained by depriving other people.

focus_anchor.role: The focus condemns a class whose self-advantage is produced by an asymmetric standard, creating the question of whether striving itself is blamed.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant well-being and bestowed favor establish the positive field toward which the later striving points.
The pure, choice drink supplies a concrete precious object in the immediately preceding description.
The complete two-word occurrence activates the branch of precious value desired by selves and rivalry for it.

structural_cues.role: States the condemned class.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
structural_cues.role: Shows that their pursuit of fullness is relationally at other people's expense when paired with 83:3.
Introduces the contrasting positive condition.

structural_cues.quote_ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
structural_cues.role: Explicitly redirects competition toward 'that' after the positive drink imagery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening describes acquisitiveness corrupted by a switched standard, while the later imperative positively licenses competition whose object is the preceding blessed good. The contrast relocates the fault from intensity of desire to the means and relation by which advantage is secured.

changed_reading.before: The demand for fullness could be overgeneralized into a condemnation of wanting or striving for more.
changed_reading.after: The condemned feature is exploitative asymmetry; vigorous aspiration can coexist when directed toward the positively marked good rather than produced through another's deficit.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied elements are the positive نعيم and pure-drink descriptions and the imperative to compete 'in that.' The reader supplies the contrast with the opening acquisition pattern and takes ذَٰلِكَ as pointing to the immediately described good. A live alternative is that the imperative is an independent exhortation rather than a deliberate qualification of the focus.
context_deltas.containment: Keep this as an exploratory contrastive implication, not a general theory that all competition is benign or that the passage licenses any means used for a good end.

context_deltas.reading: The closing reversal gives the woe a reciprocal shape: ridicule changes sides, and the final question casts the outcome as recompense returning to the doers.

focus_anchor.role: The opening pronouncement is reread through the closing scene that shows adverse consequence returning to actors.

activation_trace.role: The object-of-laughter and mockery branch identifies the criminals' initial relation to the believers.
The same mockery-capable image recurs with subject and object groups reversed.
The branch images recompense as what returns to a person from the deed, naming the logic of the reversal.
The ordinary act/deed image fixes the returned recompense to what the actors themselves were doing.

structural_cues.role: Announces adverse consequence before its reciprocal form is narrated.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: Sets the first direction of derision.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: The temporal فَٱلْيَوْمَ and reversed group order enact the turn.

structural_cues.quote_ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
structural_cues.role: The closing question explicitly evaluates the ending as requital for prior action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same laughter construction is repeated with its social direction reversed, and فَٱلْيَوْمَ marks the temporal turn. The final ثُوِّبَ question then interprets that reversal as deed-linked return, giving the opening woe a narrative form.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns shortchangers without depicting how consequence meets them.
changed_reading.after: The warning participates in a larger reciprocity: a one-way advantage or derision is finally answered by a return tied to what its agents did.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored laughter clauses and the recompense-return branch. Reading the close as a formal elaboration of the opening woe is a whole-window compositional inference. The later labels criminals and disbelievers are not explicitly declared identical with muṭaffifīn, so the relation can be thematic and structural rather than co-referential.
context_deltas.containment: Use the reversal to characterize the warning's justice-shape, not to authorize human retaliation or assert identity among every condemned label in the surah.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Exploratorily, material short-measuring can model social under-valuation: mockers diminish believers through laughter and a verdict of straying while behaving as though authorized to assess them, although they were not sent as guardians.

focus_anchor.role: The agent label anchors the source-domain of giving another less than the governing standard requires.

activation_trace.role: Literal shorting of measure and weight fixes the material source-domain before any social analogy is attempted.
The mockery image supplies a noncommercial practice that lowers another person socially.
Going astray from guidance and aim is the content of the mockers' dismissive classification.
The guarding and watching image identifies the role whose commission the verse explicitly negates.

structural_cues.role: Anchors the short-measure agent image.
Makes the literal under-allocation toward other people visible.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: Introduces interpersonal diminishment through derision.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
structural_cues.role: Shows the mockers issuing a categorical negative assessment on seeing the believers.
Immediately denies that they were commissioned to watch over those they judge.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The opening provides a concrete schema of applying a deficient standard to others. The closing social sequence repeats the relational direction in a different domain: laughter and the 'astray' verdict discount the viewed group, while the negated guardian commission exposes the assessors' lack of warrant.

changed_reading.before: Tatfīf concerns the under-allocation of measurable goods in an exchange.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the same one-sided standard can illuminate under-crediting persons through ridicule and unauthorized moral assessment.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal short-measure, mockery, the verdict of straying, and the negated guardian role. The transfer from quantity to social valuation is entirely reader-supplied; a live alternative is that the final mockers are simply another condemned group with no intended tatfīf analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from measured goods to social recognition, yet it remains anchored by the repeated other-directed asymmetry. Do not translate مُطَفِّفِينَ as 'mockers,' claim a lexical ط ف ف branch that the packet lacks, or assert that the opening and closing groups are identical.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Exploratorily, the shortchanger also shortchanges the self: what appears as gain from producing an external deficit returns as a settled inward dominance over the heart and then as blocked access.

focus_anchor.role: The focus supplies the paradoxical agent: one who seeks surplus by making another's share deficient.

activation_trace.role: Shorting measure and weight supplies the outward loss that the agents intentionally cause.
The image of seeking and obtaining gain is causally attached in the verse to what settles on their hearts.
The branch image of a dominance settling in the heart supplies the inward destination of repeated acquisition.
The heart as inward faculty locates the consequence in understanding and inner condition, not in the balance-pan.
Blocking access externalizes the next-stage loss following the heart condition.

structural_cues.role: Keeps the paradox attached to the focus agent rather than turning it into an independent heart theme.
States the direction of intended external loss.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
structural_cues.role: Reverses the apparent benefit by making their own acquisitions causally settle upon their hearts.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
structural_cues.role: Places blocked access immediately after the inward condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The agents cause loss outwardly while seeking completion and gain for themselves; later, ما كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ is made the cause of a heart-level settling dominance, followed by exclusion. The causal direction thus bends back toward the beneficiary, producing an ironic self-deficit.

changed_reading.before: The shortchanger seems to gain while only the counterparty bears the deficit.
changed_reading.after: The gained advantage can be read as generating an inward and relational loss for its own agent, so the apparent beneficiary is also diminished.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: Supplied elements are the causative loss in 83:3, acquisition as gain-seeking, the heart-level settling image, and subsequent blocked access. Calling their inner state a 'self-shortfall' is a reader-supplied directional metaphor. A live alternative is that 83:14 simply explains denial generally, without intentionally reversing the commercial loss vocabulary.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers deficit from a measured commodity to the agent's inward capacity and access. Keep it exploratory; it neither redefines ط ف ف nor licenses a detailed psychology beyond the stated causal sequence.

summary.ordinary_reading: Woe is pronounced upon people who use measure and weight asymmetrically: they secure full receipt from others but make what they give others deficient.
coexisting_readings: The immediate context makes the offense a deliberate, beneficiary-sensitive double standard rather than a neutral measuring error.
The warning is enlarged by public standing, lordship, exclusion, and fire, while written and marked records make a seemingly small shortfall durable and auditable.
The positive command to compete for a precious good tentatively distinguishes vigorous aspiration from advantage produced through another person's deprivation.
The closing reversal and recompense question give the opening woe a return-to-the-doer shape without proving that every later condemned label names the same people.
Two exploratory extensions remain contained: short measure as an analogy for social under-valuation, and corrupt gain as an ironic deficit that settles upon the gainer's own inward faculty.
unresolved_limits: The packet maps no Furuq target for the focus root ط ف ف, so the ordinary focus sense is text-and-morphology based and no finer branch distinction can be claimed.
The other listed root gap is غ م ز in 83:30; that ayah's text remains structurally readable, but no branch image for the mutual winking can be cited or invented.

The sequence associates muṭaffifīn with later wicked, denying, criminal, and disbelieving patterns, but it never explicitly declares all of those labels coextensive; group identity remains unresolved.

The record, competition, social-valuation, and self-deficit relations are compositional readings of the citable window; the last three require the qualifications stated above and must not be promoted into lexical certainties.
